scope: Narrow DXF MTEXT orientation serialization and LibreDWG 0.14 parser compatibility. Does not establish TABLE semantic equivalence, native rendering, whole-file closure, or support claims.

authority.relevant_rule: Group 50 is an optional rotation convenience converted to the equivalent group-11 WCS direction vector; if both group 50 and groups 11/21/31 are supplied, the last one wins.

source.profile: AC1018 ODA-converted TABLE drawing; selected *T1 source contains 7 MTEXT and 8 LINE records. The source remains outside the repository.

observed_defect.before: The isolated libdxfrw ASCII DXF wrote both group 50 and the WCS direction vector on the selected MTEXT records. LibreDWG 0.14 dxf2dwg rejected this output with 'ERROR: Invalid DXF code 50 for MTEXT'.
observed_defect.correction: Standalone and embedded MTEXT now suppress group 50 when the group-11 direction vector is authoritative. Rotation-only MTEXT still writes group 50.
observed_defect.semantic_basis: With the current field order, group 11 was already last and authoritative under Autodesk's rule. Omitting the redundant angle preserves orientation and improves compatibility with this independent parser.

dxf.result: No group 50 is emitted for the selected vector-oriented MTEXT records.

observed_diagnostics: Expected a CODE 4 handle, got a 3 (repeated)
libredwg.interpretation: The converter and reader completed successfully despite the recorded warnings. Entity count and presence of placement, direction, text/style and endpoint fields were checked; full source-to-peer field equality was not checked.

regression.result: PASS 1/1. ASCII and Binary tests cover standalone and embedded MTEXT; readback preserves the WCS direction and derived 30-degree angle, and ASCII output omits redundant group 50 in both bodies.

limitations: The comparison source and output are an isolated *T1 resource; the original TABLE entity and complete source dependency graph are absent.
LibreDWG conversion emitted nonfatal header and handle warnings.
No independent value-by-value geometry/text comparison, native AutoCAD/ODA rendering, or complete TABLE semantic validation was performed.
No DWG/DXF fixture was added to the repository.
